inner_arch.axiom: At Melania, every time you enter the square you are caught in the middle of a ceaseless dialogue; return after years and the same dialogue continues unbroken though its mortal speakers have died and been replaced through role cascades, chorus splits, or solitary concentrations, while the population renews itself from birth to grave and the overarching plot inches imperceptibly toward future denouements.
inner_arch.causal_law: Mortal citizens are ephemeral vessels for immortal dramatic masks: striking any citizen dead or returning after years never drops a single beat of dialogue (droppedBeats === 0); instead, deceased speakers pass to the outer Cypress Necropolis, adjacent survivors cascade into vacated roles (or split 1-to-chorus, or concentrate chorus-to-1), newborns enter from the birth porticoes, and secular denouement progress advances asymptotically across centuries.
